description: Import articles from an external blog, RSS feed, or Blogger URL into a PostKing publication as drafts. Returns id+title+slug by default (short); use detail='medium' for wordCount. Inspect individual articles with get_blog_article.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

publicationId.description: Blog publication ID to import into

sourceUrl.description: URL of the blog or RSS feed

name: import_blog_articles
